title: Steve Austin vs. The Rock: the WrestleMania trilogy
summary: The Attitude Era rivals meet at three WrestleManias. Austin wins the first two, including a shocking alliance with McMahon, before Rock finally defeats him.

chapters.title: Austin wins their first WrestleMania meeting
chapters.result: Austin defeats The Rock to win the WWF championship.

chapters.title: Austin accepts McMahon’s help
chapters.result: Austin defeats Rock for the title with McMahon involved.
chapters.context: The victory ends with Austin aligned with his former enemy.

chapters.title: Rock finally wins at WrestleMania
chapters.context: The trilogy closes with Rock’s first WrestleMania victory over Austin.
